entries.description: **Give every launch its own `APPDATA` / `LOCALAPPDATA`** (and `HOME` / `USERPROFILE`) pointing at a fresh tmpdir. `vscode-launch.js::electronEnv` merges its `extra` argument **after** allowlist filtering, and `electronLaunch.ts` already has a `homeOverride` path for `HOME`/`USERPROFILE` — so this extends an existing seam rather than inventing one. Keep the allowlist discipline intact: the point is to *scope* these variables, not to widen what is inherited.

**Re-test the ceiling.** Re-run the 8-worker configuration that previously failed. If isolation fixes both the failures and the speedup, the ceiling is far above 4 and the whole "bounded workers" framing relaxes. Sweep upward from the last known-good rather than assuming a cap.

**Record the outcome either way.** If failures persist under full isolation, they are **product races** exposed by a schedule this suite has never run — a real finding, out of scope to fix, and it must be written down rather than relabelled as flakiness.
Full Layer 3 and pytest at close after freeze; verify, close.
Register. start_session ran for session 1 of 3; state flipped to in-progress; orchestrator claude/anthropic/claude-opus-5/high recorded.

Step 2 opened. APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA scoping already landed pre-session in commit 5388c3d1 (inline in electronLaunch.ts, untested, sibling site stage-walk.js not covered). This session moves it to the shared vscode-launch.js seam, covers it with falsifiable tests, and settles HOME/USERPROFILE by measurement.

Ceiling sweep running on DENICI (20 logical CPUs, 63.8 GB) with full per-launch isolation, real-host-baseline excluded for comparability with the 14-core figures. w=8: 35 passed, 206s, exit 0 -- the vsix-first-run-walkthrough failure seen pre-HOME-scoping did not recur. w=4, w=12 and w=1 pending.

Sweep complete on DENICI, 35 tests, real-host-baseline excluded, all four counts green: w=1 548s / w=4 231s (2.37x) / w=8 206s (2.66x) / w=12 189s (2.90x). Ceiling is ABOVE 12 here, where the 14-core host went red with 8 failures at the same count. Speedup saturates at ~4 workers: marginal wall clock per added worker is 105.7s (1->4), 6.3s (4->8), 4.3s (8->12). Cost is per-test inflation -- 2.46x the total work at w=12 for 2.90x wall clock. Recorded in s1-worker-sweep-DENICI.txt.

makeLaunchStateDirs() added to scripts/vscode-launch.js (the shared seam) and called by BOTH launch sites: electronLaunch.ts (replacing the inline block from 5388c3d1) and stage-walk.js, which the inline fix had missed -- npm run walk had still been launching against the operator's real machine-wide VS Code profile (L-069-1). HOME/USERPROFILE scoped alongside APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA so the isolation is not Windows-only; journaled. 16 new tests in launchStateIsolation.test.ts, every positive assertion paired with its planted look-alike (L-112-1); both falsifiers executed -- killing the overlay fails 8 tests while the control still passes, and a planted re-implementation fires the sibling-site rule. The first falsifier caught a weak assertion of my own (matching a type declaration rather than a call), now tightened.

Verdict recorded in s1-worker-sweep-DENICI.txt section 3. Every failure in 12 runs is ONE test (vsix-first-run-walkthrough); the other 34 never failed at any worker count. Two distinct modes: palette-within-15s under w=8 load (2 of 4 runs), and a 300s timeout waiting on a REAL PyPI pip install when run ALONE at one worker (1 of 3). Refutes CPU contention (w=12 x3 all green, strictly more load), refutes shared state (full isolation did not change the rate), and refutes parallelism as the cause (it failed alone at w=1). Not fixed, per the spec's non-goals. BLOCKING input to Session 2: this defeats its three-consecutive-green control at ~1-in-4 at any worker count.

Close suites on the FINAL tree, after every code-changing stage: Layer 3 FULL (36 tests incl. real-host-baseline, shipping workers:1) 36 passed in 659s; pytest -n 8 (operator cap, not pytest.ini's -n auto) 3850 passed / 5 skipped in 297s; mocha 1689 passing / 1 failing on the pre-existing sampleProjectSmoke gate_failed reproduced on clean master. All three recorded via run_of_record. Verification: round 1 discovery (2 lenses, 4 blocking) -> remediate all 4 Majors + 7 nits -> round 2 remediation-review (1 accepted, 1 rejected). The rejected one asks for a measurement on the 14-core host, unreachable from this machine; operator adjudicated to close with it as an owed residual owned by Session 2.
